note: Clay County Conservation park near Everly: 55 acres around a 15-acre spring-fed fishing lake (the county calls it a pond) with a sand swimming beach, fishing pier and jetties, concession with paddle boat, canoe, kayak and paddleboard rentals, disc golf, and three rental cabins. The campground fills the southeast corner behind the pier parking and the park road. Reservations for Clay County Fair week are by phone only. --Claude

WATERFRONT: 'lakeview' kept. Size: on NAIP the water is about 415 x 190 m, roughly 5.5 ha (~14 acres), consistent with the county's '15 acre pond', and over the 5-acre line. The curation doc also says to treat it as a pond when the operator calls it one ('a 15 acre pond'); I followed the brief's reading that 15 acres is a lake, but that clause would make it 'not waterfront'. Which pads face it: the north row (sites 61*, 60*, 59*, 58*, 56*, 54*, 52*, 50*) looks north over the fishing-pier parking lot and a mowed strip to the south shore, ~30-35 m. The west row of the east column (sites 39-45 area) faces the east shore ~25 m away across the campground road and a thin, gappy line of shoreline trees. A loop road or parking lot lies between every pad and the water, so there are no open-apron lakefront pads. The swim beach is on the far (southwest) side.
